# `Q-13-17` — Invalid announcement option

> A `website.announcement` option has a value Quarto does not
> recognize. The default is used and the banner still renders.

## What this means

Two announcement options accept a fixed set of values:

| option | values | default |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `danger`, `warning`, `info`, `light`, `dark` | `primary` |
| `position` | `above-navbar`, `below-navbar` | `above-navbar` |

`type` selects the banner's colors (the matching Bootstrap alert
style); `position` places the banner before or after the navbar.
Any other value is replaced by the default, and this warning names
the option and the value.

## Why this happens

- **A typo** — `warn`, `error`, `below`.
- **A color name** in `type`, such as `yellow` or `red`. Pick the
  alert style with that color instead (`warning`, `danger`).

## How to fix

Use one of the values in the table above, or remove the option to
get the default.
